title: A Prototype System for Evolutionary Information Layering: A Retrospective Evidence Audit of Seven Decades of Mammalian Sucking Research
content: Frameworks that propose general principles of biological organization earn credibility not through explanatory reach but through confrontation with experimental records produced for purposes independent of the framework. Evolutionary Information Layering (EIL) proposes that nervous-system function decomposes into functional layers with partly independent developmental clocks, that behavioral performance is dominated by inter-layer coupling rather than within-layer capacity, and that development and recovery proceed mainly by reweighting existing layers. This paper reports a retrospective evidence audit of the framework's core propositions against seven decades of published research on mammalian sucking, chosen as a prototype system because its inter-layer interfaces are sharp, its components mature on dissociated clocks, and its coordination metrics are already operationalized. Five core propositions (K1-K5) and one candidate (K6) were translated into falsification conditions fixed before the evidence was examined; the published record was then graded on a pre-fixed three-tier scale (direct support, consistency, no data). Three propositions received direct support from data collected by independent groups for independent purposes: functional layering (dissociated maturation of the suck-swallow and swallow-respiration interfaces), coupling primacy (four independent lines converge on coupling rather than amplitude as the limiting variable), and reweighting dominance (longitudinal electromyography and dual-generator studies show changing weights on conserved hardware). Two propositions received graded consistency: low-level persistence (pathological reappearance of the sucking reflex; reuse of the jaw oscillator in speech) and ordered restoration (a fixed maturational sequence; differential efficacy of interface-targeted versus component-targeted exercise). The candidate proposition on value anchoring retains candidate status with documented leads. The audit additionally yields a cross-domain coupling metrology and explicit eligibility criteria for prototype systems. All evidence is retrospective by design; the framework's decisive tests remain prospective.
